mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_system_config ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_system_config (config_key, config_value, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{configKey}, #{configValue}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE t_system_config SET config_value = #{configValue}, description = #{description}, update_time = NOW() WHERE config_key = #{configKey}
